# Image colour variants — 2026-10-23

Generated with the built-in image_gen tool from the user's existing originals. Original files are unchanged.

- folia-grey-v1.png: input ../44422.png. Colour-only brief: preserve packaging composition, illustrations, lettering and chocolate; change yellow tabletop to neutral grey #D2D2D2, red to dusty rose, green to sage-grey and yellow to subdued taupe. Retain natural cocoa colour and paper texture.
- velora-grey-v1.png: input ../7e173.png. Colour-only brief: preserve two hanging tags, butterfly shapes, staggered lettering, strings and shadows; replace brown background with neutral grey #CAC8CC, use dusty mauve #81717F and pearl grey #E0DDDE tags with plum #655563 print.

Display derivatives are assets/opt/folia-grey-v1-{800,1600}.webp and assets/opt/velora-grey-v1-{800,1600}.webp. app.js maps only the two original main visuals to these variants, consistently across homepage, details and enlarged view. Layout and global website colours are unchanged.
